statement: TSMC reported August 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$514.81 billion, up 53.3 percent year over year and 10.1 percent from July 2026.
why: Monthly foundry revenue is the fastest hard read on whether AI silicon is actually shipping, and an acceleration to 53.3 percent says wafer output is still climbing, not plateauing.

impact.mechanism: Record foundry revenue reflects wafer and packaging output being consumed by AI accelerator and networking customers, confirming that shipments behind the order book are being made.

evidence.excerpt: Consolidated revenue for August 2026 was 'NT$514.81 billion', an increase of '10.1 percent' from July 2026 (month-over-month) and an increase of '53.3 percent' from August 2025 (year-over-year).

confidence.basis: Primary evidence: company revenue report filed as a Form 6-K with the SEC.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 39.3 -> 53.3 (tol 1%); sources: SEC EDGAR (TSMC Form 6-K)
